linkedin_post:
Documentation is finally getting the infrastructure treatment it deserves.

Notion as Code just entered beta, and it's solving a problem every dev team faces: keeping documentation in sync with rapidly evolving codebases.

Here's what makes this a game-changer:

✅ Version control your entire Notion workspace
✅ Deploy workspace configurations alongside your code
✅ Automate documentation updates through your CI/CD pipeline
✅ Treat your knowledge base like infrastructure-as-code

No more manual updates. No more outdated docs. No more context switching between your repo and your workspace.

For teams embracing DevOps culture, this bridges the final gap between where code lives and where knowledge lives. Your documentation can now evolve at the same pace as your product.

If you're tired of documentation drift, this beta is worth exploring.

Full details on what Notion as Code enables: https://saaspulsemedia.com/articles/now-in-beta-notion-as-code-a-2026-game-changer-for-developer-p6p4.html
